Package Models

Class Phase

java.lang.Object
Models.Phase
Direct Known Subclasses:
IssueOrderPhase, OrderExecutionPhase, StartUpPhase
public abstract class Phase extends Object
Phase class represents an abstract phase in the game flow. This class provides methods to handle different commands during the game phases.
